scope: Owned domain per-node content transitions/layout styles/light facts plus opaque preparation and repository contracts. No source outside listed eight files changed by this producer.
sourceManifestAlgorithm: SHA256 of ordered sha256 + two spaces + relative path + LF

requirements.identity: ContentSlotKey=(LayoutScope,LayoutNodeId); existing node cannot be repurposed between content types. New type requires fresh high-water node identity.
requirements.authorization: Begin and Finish repeat IdentityState validation/local GlobalAdmin authority/current target; Subject requires enabled exact triple assignment. Trusted composition retains original exact session lease; domain never imports session/SQLite/native handles.
requirements.ordering: Begin durably advances latest_publish_sequence before preparation. Failure only clears exact pending admission and never rewinds sequence; late A after newer failed B remains Superseded.
requirements.CAS: Content revision independent of layout/profile and view revision. Page uses exact content+view CAS and does not supersede pending publish. Clear and explicit previous-revision Undo create new content revisions; one previous committed version is retained.
requirements.text: Text and TXT-prepared text share 10000 Unicode scalar/40000 UTF8-byte maximum, preserve formatting, reject binary controls except CR/LF/TAB. No TXT parser claimed here.
requirements.images: Ordered 1..50 references; PNG/JPEG/BMP, nonzero <=10MiB and <=8000000 pixels, immutable independent MediaVersionId plus exact owner/hash/size/dimensions. Pixel decode and persistent ID allocation belong to actual adapters/storage.
requirements.quota: 2GiB shared primary originals policy (materials plus content; separate namespace/ownership) and independent cache budgets. Failure settlement cannot release live physical worker/file quota.
requirements.styles: LayoutDocument and SubjectProfileDocument content_styles exact node/type bindings. Multiple same-kind nodes have separate ComponentSettings; ALL remains eight builtin globals. Style changes advance appropriate document/layout revision; reset clears styles and allocates fresh IDs.
requirements.facts: DesktopFacts.profile_contents only current active tree snapshots; each text/image slot has exactly one lightweight descriptor including empty unpublished slot. Text descriptor counts/hash only, image descriptor current reference/total_pages only; no body/manifest/history/pending in Facts.
requirements.digests: Domain canonical fingerprint_bytes is independent of JSON/SQLite. Trusted preparation sha256 port hashes actual canonical payload and raw UTF8 separately; PreparedProfileContent private fields/no new/Clone/Deserialize. Writer must independently recompute before commit and on strict decode; Begin intent fingerprint is not a resource verification hash.

transitions: fail(&admission)->Result<Self> trusted settlement, not authority grant
page(&PageContentRequest)->Result<Self> exact published capability required in composition
api.preparation: fc_ports::prepare_profile_content(&mut ProfileContentPreparation,admission,input)->PreparedProfileContent; adapter supplies actual SHA256 via sha256(&[u8]); into_parts() returns admission,payload,digests to trusted writer
api.pageCapability: page repository has no fabricated ActorContext. Default-denied exact current scene generation/source/node/content guard is mandatory at trusted composition and commit.
